note:
⛔ SNG-448. THE VEIL — Erik, 2026-08-15. 'Fundamentally we have CRYSTAL LATTICE SUBSTRATE from the Precursors (the god-aliens who created earth), and we have THE OTHER SIDE — what the Veil holds back. THE VEIL IS THE DIVIDE, and gets SOLIDIFIED BY LATTICE and THINNED BY VEILWORK.'
⚠️ THIS IS A SECOND AXIS AND IT RUNS PERPENDICULAR TO THE POWER SOURCES. A source says what you draw on; VEIL EFFECT says what your drawing DOES TO THE DIVIDE. ⛔ Nobody has to intend it and everybody is doing it.
whatItIs: ⛔ THE VEIL IS THE DIVIDE BETWEEN THIS SIDE AND THE OTHER SIDE. It is not a place, a wall or a work — canon: 'powered by an ABSENCE, not a substance', 'the MIRROR of precursor'. ⚠️ And SNG-442: it is what remains where Kenosis stopped being present. THE DIVIDE IS THE SHAPE OF A DEATH.

veilEffect._statement: ⛔ EVERY CRAFT SITS SOMEWHERE ON THIS AXIS, AND ONLY FOUR POSITIONS EXIST.

strengthens.how: ⛔ THE SUBSTRATE SOLIDIFIES THE DIVIDE. Every line laid, every seal held, every waygate kept is the Veil made thicker. ⚠️ Which reframes Akinetos entirely: the lattice is not only war infrastructure, it is the WALL, and the war was about whether to have one.

⚠️ Humans reproducing lattice behaviour reproduce its effect. The Enginewrights and the Lattice-Cities thicken the divide by imitation, and the Seraphim by administration. ⛔ THEY DO NOT NECESSARILY KNOW THIS.

thins.how: ⛔ THE ONE CRAFT WORKING THE PURE FORM DIRECTLY. Falsecraft thins by using it — a Veilwright does not decide to weaken the divide any more than a road decides to wear.

⛔ THE THINNINGS ARE APPARATUS FOR THIS AND ARE AS OLD AS THE SUBSTRATE (SNG-446). ⚠️ ANY metaphysical practice performed AT a Thinning contributes, whatever the practitioner thought they were doing. The Numinous sit beside `the_thinning` for the meaning-density and have been paying into the machine for four centuries.

neutral.how: ⚠️ Ungoverned, and the divide does not register it either way. The Churnfolk and the Rootkin are genuinely not in this war.

⛔ THE IMPORTANT NEUTRAL. Soma, the Edge, Stillcraft, Noesis and Palework draw on the same SOURCE as Veilwork and have NO veil effect, because they turn it INWARD. ⚠️ Erik: 'HOW people use the metaphysics varies but we don't need to break down the power source for those uses.' THE SOURCE IS ONE THING; THE USE IS ANOTHER, AND THE USE IS WHAT ACTS ON THE DIVIDE.

byTradition.Light: ⚠️ MIXED — Radiance strengthens (precursor), Verity neutral (ki). The sects disagree without knowing it.
byTradition.Dark: ⛔ MIXED, AND SHARPLY — Umbracraft strengthens (precursor, in the deeps), Falsecraft THINS. The one tradition holding both ends of the axis.
byTradition.Order: ⛔ STRENGTHENS, hardest of anyone. Both sects, ordered nanite, and Latticework is deliberate imitation of the wall.
byTradition.Angelic: ⛔ STRENGTHENS. Ordered primary, precursor secondary — both directions the same way. The Seraphim are the wall's party whether or not they say so.
byTradition.Demonic: ⛔ THINS. Precursor primary but METAPHYSICAL SECONDARY, and that secondary is the point: Lucifer fell to wanting the other side through.
byTradition.Spirit: ⚠️ THINS, MOSTLY UNWITTINGLY. Metaphysical primary, and they work at Thinnings because that is where meaning is densest.
byTradition.Building: strengthens — Makecraft is precursor; Stillcraft neutral.
byTradition.Breaking: ⚠️ mixed-neutral — the Edge is ki (neutral), Ruinwork is precursor but UNMAKES lattice, so it may THIN by removal. ⛔ Erik's call: does destroying lattice thin the Veil?
byTradition.Span: strengthens — waygates are lattice, and keeping them keeps the wall.
byTradition.Mind: ⚠️ neutral, mostly. Noesis is ki-inward; Logos is ordered (slight strengthen); Formcraft is wild (neutral).
byTradition.Death: neutral — Palework is inward, Pathos is wild.

veilNexuses:
⛔ ERIK: 'The Veil nexus locations could be ESTABLISHED GATES TO THE OTHER SIDE.'
⚠️ SO A VEIL NEXUS IS NOT A THIN PATCH — IT IS A DOOR SOMEBODY BUILT, and the Thinnings are the ones we know about. ⛔ THAT MAKES THEM DIFFERENT IN KIND FROM THE OTHER NEXUS TYPES (SNG-446: natural, consecrated, forced): those are places where a power is ACCESSIBLE. A Veil nexus is a place where something can COME THROUGH.
⚠️ `the_thinning` is already canon, already a tier-2 waygate, and already has the Numinous living beside it. It should be the first one placed.
_theConflictThisCreates:
⛔ THIS IS THE SETTING'S ACTUAL WAR AND ALMOST NOBODY IN IT KNOWS THEY ARE ENLISTED. The Enginewrights thicken the divide by building well. The Veilwrights thin it by working. The Numinous thin it by sitting still in the wrong place. ⚠️ AND THE CHURNFOLK, ROOTKIN, SOMATICS AND MARCHERS ARE GENUINELY NEUTRAL — which makes them the only people either side can trust as messengers, and the only ones with nothing at stake.
⛔ IT ALSO EXPLAINS THE ORDERED/WILD CONVERSION FIGHT (SNG-446) AS SOMETHING LARGER THAN FUEL: every district the Seraphim and Enginewrights order is a district where the wall thickens, and the Rootkin and Churnfolk breaking it back down are — without meaning to — undoing that too.
